Convergence research for sustainable regional systems
abstract: Convergence research addresses societal and environmental challenges by co-creating knowledge across disciplinary boundaries, often in deep collaboration with extra-academic parties to ensure that the research process is solution-focused, actionable, and just. As part of National Science Foundation (NSF)-funded research projects on sustainable regional systems, we present multiple perspectives on conducting convergence research within the coupled social-ecological-technological systems framework. These projects explicitly engage extra-academic parties to co-design and co-produce knowledge throughout all stages of this participatory research. We introduce the 3 C's model as a framework that links a research team's Communication, Collaboration, and Creation decisions to the likely degree of convergence and societal change achieved. This model assesses the degree of integration among different social sciences, biophysical sciences, engineering, and other scientific disciplines, as well as extra-academic partners ranging from governmental agencies and industries to non-profit organizations and tribal communities. Integration in this context is assessed by its ability to situate local problems within broader systemic lenses, resolve conflicts among the priorities of partners, and conduct cutting-edge research that addresses real-world needs with actionable sustainability solutions. By synthesizing inclusive and just practices of conducting convergent research across a selection of research teams, we provide recommendations for academic researchers and administrators to encourage and advance convergence research in solving challenging sustainability issues.
abstract_zh: 融合研究（convergence research）通过跨学科边界共同创造知识来应对社会和环境挑战，并且常常与学术界以外的各方进行深入合作，以确保研究过程以解决问题为导向、具有可操作性且公正。作为美国国家科学基金会（NSF）资助的可持续区域系统研究项目的一部分，我们在耦合的社会—生态—技术系统框架内，展示了开展融合研究的多种视角。这些项目在参与式研究的各个阶段，都明确与学术界以外的各方合作，共同设计和生产知识。我们提出“3C”模型，将研究团队的沟通（Communication）、协作（Collaboration）和创造（Creation）决策，与可能实现的融合程度和社会变革联系起来。该模型评估了不同社会科学、生物物理科学、工程学及其他科学学科之间，以及从政府机构、产业到非营利组织和部落社区等学术界以外合作伙伴之间的整合程度。在这一语境下，整合的评估依据在于：能否将地方问题置于更广泛的系统视角之中，能否协调合作伙伴之间的优先事项冲突，以及能否开展前沿研究以满足现实需求并提供可行的可持续性解决方案。通过综合一系列研究团队在包容性和公正性方面的融合研究实践，我们为学术研究者和管理者提供了建议，以鼓励和推进融合研究，应对具有挑战性的可持续性问题。

Incentive Contracts for Environmental Services and Their Potential in REDD
venue: International Review of Environmental and Resource Economics
abstract: Projects for reducing emissions from deforestation and forest degradation (REDD) have not been widely adopted by carbon credit schemes due to the inherent problems with forest carbon credits that often lead to high transaction costs given the complications of measuring, monitoring, and verifying credits. Incentive-based contracts, where it is in the best interest of the environmental service users and providers to comply with the contracts, may be one way to reduce these costs if providers have incentives to uphold their end of the contract. While the literature on REDD is extensive, there is little information available to guide policymakers or investors on what form such contracts should take. After providing an overview of the current status of REDD and its role as a tool for reducing carbon emissions on an international scale, this paper considers the key issues that need to be addressed when implementing REDD projects, and how contracts can be designed to alleviate some of the subsequent problems with carbon credits. We draw from the literature on agricultural contracts, payments for ecosystem services, and other environmental service-related contracts and discuss the various implications associated with their design and implementation.
abstract_zh: 减少毁林和森林退化所致排放（REDD）项目尚未被碳信用体系广泛采纳，原因在于森林碳信用固有的问题，这些问题往往导致较高的交易成本，因为碳信用的测量、监测和核查十分复杂。激励型合同可能是降低这些成本的一种途径，前提是环境服务的使用者和提供者都有动机履行合同义务，即遵守合同符合各方的最佳利益。尽管关于REDD的文献十分丰富，但几乎没有信息能够指导政策制定者或投资者应采用何种合同形式。在概述REDD的现状及其作为国际规模减少碳排放工具的作用之后，本文考察了实施REDD项目时需要解决的关键问题，以及如何设计合同来缓解碳信用相关的后续问题。我们借鉴了农业合同、生态系统服务付费以及其他环境服务相关合同的文献，并讨论了其设计与实施所涉及的各种影响。

The Risk Attitudes of U.S. Farmers
abstract: I compare the distribution of risk attitudes of farm owners in the United States to nonfarm business owners and the general population using a measure of risk tolerance collected from national surveys. I find that farmers are significantly more tolerant of risk than the general population, though they are significantly less tolerant of risk than nonfarm business owners. Once demographic differences are controlled, farm and nonfarm business owners are more similar in their risk attitudes and both groups remain significantly more risk tolerant than the general population. First‐generation farmers display greater risk tolerance than farmers who inherit operations from family members, as do farmers who have just begun operating a farm; neither pattern emerges among nonfarm business owners. The most risk tolerant farmers are young and male with larger operations, higher incomes, less formal education and close proximity to metropolitan centers. Among farmers, those with less diversified operations and those with specialty enterprises are more risk tolerant than other types of farmers. Crop farmers are less risk tolerant than fruit and vegetable farmers or farmers with specialty enterprises, while farmers who receive government payments or buy enterprise insurance are not significantly different in risk tolerance from farmers who eschew such opportunities. These findings stimulate questions about how farm programs and the distinct challenges of entry in the production agriculture sector shape the underlying distribution of key farmer characteristics such as risk tolerance.
abstract_zh: 我利用全国性调查收集的风险容忍度指标，比较了美国农场主与非农企业主及一般人群的风险态度分布。我发现，农场主的风险容忍度显著高于一般人群，但显著低于非农企业主。在控制了人口特征差异后，农场主与非农企业主的风险态度更为相似，且两类群体的风险容忍度仍都显著高于一般人群。第一代农场主比从家庭成员处继承经营权的农场主表现出更高的风险容忍度，刚开始经营农场的农场主同样如此；而非农企业主中则未出现这一规律。风险容忍度最高的农场主年轻、为男性，经营规模较大、收入较高、正规教育程度较低，并且靠近大都市中心。在农场主之中，经营较不多元化以及从事特色经营的农场主，比其他类型的农场主更能容忍风险。大田作物农场主的风险容忍度低于果蔬农场主或特色经营农场主；而领取政府补贴或购买企业保险的农场主，与不这样做的农场主在风险容忍度上并无显著差异。这些发现引发了一些问题：农业计划以及进入农业生产部门所面临的独特挑战，如何塑造了风险容忍度等农场主关键特征的基础分布。

Public vs. Private Eco-Labeling of Environmental Credence Goods: Maximizing the Gains from International Integration
venue: Journal of Agricultural & Food Industrial Organization
abstract: Using a model of vertical product differentiation, we analyze the welfare gains from economic integration when countries harmonize their eco-labeling and certification policies for environmental credence goods. Specifically, we show that harmonized mandatory, exclusive discrete labeling will not maximize the gains from economic integration, i.e., the choice of eco-labeling regime can have a negative effect on market structure if firms choose to exit, reducing the range and quality of goods in the integrated market, and thereby reducing aggregate environmental benefits. In contrast, under a harmonized mandatory, non-exclusive discrete labeling regime, private certification increases the likelihood of maximizing the gains from international economic integration.
abstract_zh: 利用垂直产品差异化模型，我们分析了各国协调其环境信用品（environmental credence goods）生态标签和认证政策时，经济一体化所带来的福利收益。具体而言，我们表明，统一的强制性排他性离散标签制度无法使经济一体化的收益最大化，即若企业选择退出，所选择的标签制度可能对市场结构产生负面影响，减少一体化市场中商品的种类和质量范围，从而降低总体环境效益。相比之下，在统一的强制性非排他性离散标签制度下，私人认证会提高实现国际经济一体化收益最大化的可能性。

The Value of Agricultural Economics Extension Programming: An Application of Contingent Valuation
abstract: We use the contingent valuation method to estimate participant willingness to pay for agricultural economics extension programming. The data, collected as part of standard evaluation forms for the Ohio State University's 2001 Agricultural Outlook and Policy program series, and subsequent analysis suggest participant benefits exceeded departmental costs of conducting the program (benefit-cost ratios of 1.07 under conservative assumptions and 1.74 under moderate assumptions). We also use the data to explore the revenue generation potential from alternative program pricing and discuss the potential for developing differentiated programs to reach distinct audience segments. Additional research necessary before implementing alternative pricing or program differentiation plans is also discussed.
abstract_zh: 我们采用条件价值评估法（contingent valuation）估计参与者为农业经济推广项目支付的意愿。数据来源于俄亥俄州立大学2001年“农业展望与政策”系列项目的标准评估表，经后续分析表明，参与者的收益超过了该系开展项目的成本（在保守假设下收益成本比为1.07，在适中假设下为1.74）。我们还利用这些数据探讨了不同项目定价方式下的收入创造潜力，并讨论了开发差异化项目以覆盖不同受众群体的可能性。文中还讨论了在实施替代定价或项目差异化计划之前仍需开展的研究。

title: The Economics of Labeling: An Overview of Issues for Health and Environmental Disclosure
abstract: During the last two decades, product labeling has become an increasingly used policy tool, particularly with respect to the provision of health and environmental information. Theory holds that the flow of information among market participants plays a critical role in the efficient operation of markets. This paper explores the role of product labeling policy in ameliorating two potential market deficiencies: asymmetric information and costly search behavior. Practical considerations for the design and implementation of labeling policy and of labeling research are explored.
abstract_zh: 在过去二十年中，产品标签已日益成为一种常用的政策工具，尤其是在提供健康和环境信息方面。理论认为，市场参与者之间的信息流动对市场的有效运行起着关键作用。本文探讨了产品标签政策在缓解两类潜在市场缺陷方面的作用：信息不对称和代价高昂的搜寻行为。文中还探讨了标签政策及标签研究在设计与实施方面的实际考量。
